name: whatsapp
description: WhatsApp bot (Baileys): message it and it replies through Elowen AI. Text commands (/model, /new, /help), a model picker for each chat (numbered menu, reply with a number), live-updating messages with a tool-call summary, status reactions and proactive notices from cron/tick tasks. Group tools: view and browse groups, create groups, add and remove members, and send messages to any chat (operator). Each sender (phone number, JID or whole group) is assigned allowed Elowen projects and a role prompt. Link the account by scanning a QR code or entering a pairing code.

configSchema.label: Connection
configSchema.hint: How the bot links to WhatsApp and where it pushes proactively. Pair by scanning the QR code from the plugin logs, or with a pairing code.

configSchema.label: Pairing phone number
configSchema.hint: Optional: the bot's WhatsApp number in international format WITHOUT +, spaces or dashes (e.g. 420777123456). When set, the plugin prints an 8-character pairing code to the logs instead of a QR — enter it in WhatsApp → Linked devices → Link with phone number. Leave empty to pair by QR.

configSchema.label: Allowed groups
configSchema.hint: Group JIDs (…@g.us) where the bot may respond. Empty = every group where a mapped sender writes. Direct chats remain allowed for mapped senders.

configSchema.label: Notification chat
configSchema.hint: Where proactive messages (cron/tick results, escalations, restart notices) are posted — a phone number or a JID (…@s.whatsapp.net / …@g.us). Empty = no proactive pushes.

configSchema.label: Replies & behavior
configSchema.hint: When and how the bot answers.

configSchema.label: Respond without mention
configSchema.hint: On: in groups the bot answers every message from a mapped sender. Off: in groups it only answers when @mentioned or when its message is replied to. Direct chats always get an answer.

configSchema.label: Live progress trace
configSchema.hint: Show the agent's tool trace in a message edited in place while it works. The answer itself always arrives as one message at the end. Off = only the final answer.

configSchema.label: Replace progress with answer
configSchema.hint: Show one live progress message while the agent works, then replace that same message with the final answer. No message is deleted.

configSchema.label: Processing reactions
configSchema.hint: Shows processing status using reactions on the incoming message.

configSchema.label: Runtime footer
configSchema.hint: Append a small "model · context %" line under the final reply.

configSchema.label: Show reasoning
configSchema.hint: Show the model's reasoning while it answers. Only available with extended-thinking models. Off by default.

configSchema.label: Service language
configSchema.hint: Language of the bot's own service messages (/new, /model, placeholders).

configSchema.label: Conversation
configSchema.hint: Image routing.

configSchema.label: Vision model
configSchema.hint: Model for messages with image attachments. Must support image processing. Leave empty to use the chat's normal model.

configSchema.label: Media limits
configSchema.hint: Limits for incoming and outgoing images, and how long a pending question stays open.

configSchema.label: Max inbound image size
configSchema.hint: Largest image attachment (in bytes) the bot downloads for processing. Larger files are only recorded.

configSchema.label: Max images per message
configSchema.hint: How many images from one message the bot sends to the model for recognition.

configSchema.label: Max images per reply
configSchema.hint: How many images shared by the agent the bot attaches to a single outgoing reply.

configSchema.label: Question timeout (ms)
configSchema.hint: How long a pending AskUserQuestion accepts a numbered reply or free text before it expires. The same limit applies to interactive menus.

configSchema.label: Sender policies
configSchema.hint: Map WhatsApp senders to allowed projects, a role prompt and the tools the bot may use.

configSchema.label: Sender policies
configSchema.hint: The first matching sender takes precedence. Senders without an assigned rule are ignored. The ID can be a phone number (420777123456), a JID (…@s.whatsapp.net) or a whole group JID (…@g.us). A group ID gives everyone in the group access to the bot. An asterisk * matches every sender and must come last, or it would override rules for specific senders. The `admin` key enables shared /model, /reasoning and /context menus, as well as chat control commands /stop, /stats, /compact and /restart. The /restart command restarts the daemon for everyone. Projects and tool permissions come from the sender's linked Elowen account.
